name: tr_shead
caption:
IF JAMAL SHEAD HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

⚔️ Aegislash: its Stance Change flips it between sword and shield. Big 12 Player and Defensive Player of the Year in one season, the first ever to win both
👻 Haunter: it evolves when it's traded. Pick 45 to Sacramento, traded to us that same night
🥚 Happiny: carries a round rock and gives it to its friends. 307 assists as a rookie, 2nd most by a rookie in our history
🐍 Steelix: a body harder than diamond. All 82 games last season
🦅 Xatu: it can see the future. 16 assists in our win at Milwaukee
🔥 Infernape: beaten by none in quickness. Our engine, 7.0 assists a night through 10 games, and a new 3-year extension

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Jamal Shead had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF SHEAD HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Aegislash. Its ability, Stance Change, flips it between sword and shield. At Houston: Big Twelve Player of the Year and Defensive Player of the Year. The first ever to win both.
beats.dlg: SWITCHES SWORD AND SHIELD.|BIG 12 POY AND DPOY.

beats.vo: Haunter. It evolves when it gets traded. Sacramento took him forty-fifth, and traded him to us that same night.
beats.dlg: IT EVOLVES WHEN TRADED.|PICK 45, TRADED TO US!

beats.vo: Happiny. It carries a round rock, and gives it to its friends. Three hundred seven assists as a rookie, second most by a rookie in our history.
beats.dlg: GIVES ITS ROCK TO FRIENDS.|307 ASSISTS AS A ROOKIE!

beats.vo: Steelix. Its body is harder than a diamond. Last season, he played all eighty-two games.
beats.dlg: HARDER THAN A DIAMOND.|ALL 82 GAMES LAST SEASON!

beats.vo: Xatu. It can see the future. Shead sees the pass coming: sixteen assists in our win at Milwaukee.
beats.dlg: IT CAN SEE THE FUTURE.|16 ASSISTS AT MILWAUKEE!

beats.vo: And the ace. Infernape. Nobody beats it for quickness. Our engine: seven assists a night through ten games, and a new three-year extension.
beats.dlg: BEATEN BY NONE IN SPEED.|7.0 ASSISTS, FIRST 10 GAMES

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: 2023-24 (Houston, Big 12): Big 12 Player of the Year and Defensive Player of the Year, the first player to win both awards in the same season; 2024 NBA draft: selected 45th overall by the Sacramento Kings, traded on draft night to Toronto; rookie year 307 total assists, second (2nd) among rookies in franchise history; appeared in all 82 games in 2025-26; October 1, 2026: three-year (3-year) contract extension
